analysis:
This batch contains only test changes. No production source is included.

- GLM5NextProtectedFactoryFixture.swift head 111-112 adds the <think>/</think> special tokens to the synthetic tokenizer vocabulary. The fixture keeps its test-only env overrides (DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_TEST_*, ALLOW_EPHEMERAL at lines 31-39), all of which predate this PR. Cache scope stays the fixed "fixture-tenant" value at line 255. Nothing here touches T-041 salt scoping, HMAC naming or TTL.
- GlobalKVCacheBudgetProcessTests.swift head 22-26 and SystemMemoryAdmissionTests.swift head 24-27 switch to a new SystemMemory.availableBytes(stats: vm_statistics64, ...) API through the machVMStatistics helper. The helper is defined in SystemMemoryTests.swift; that unit has metadata only, and its patch excerpt is truncated.
- The renames at SystemMemoryAdmissionTests head 39 and 98 and the comment at head 81 suggest the production .reclaimable policy changes. It may now credit file-backed/page-cache pages, possibly via external_page_count, rather than inactive pages.
- In these tests, .freeOnly admission still rejects shared-host load when only reclaimable credit exists, and rechecks still refuse when free memory falls. That keeps the expected availability posture (TB-007, T-029-style DoS/memory admission).
- The production SystemMemory.swift implementation is not in this batch. Integration should therefore verify that the .reclaimable formula does not overcount, for example anonymous inactive or compressor pages. Overcounting could lead to memory-pressure crashes of the provider (availability only, no confidentiality impact).
- No regression to encryption, attestation, authorization or data exposure was identified in these test-only changes.
